notes.settings.enabled_hint: Adds a “Notes” page to the briefing window: paste Slack / Jira links or snippets; Claude Code in WSL reads them read-only, summarizes and picks a reminder time; notes are pushed to the AI-Base-Memory repo. Each note is one real model call on that account's quota.

notes.settings.flow_hint: Hover the flow icon on the right for the whole flow, so the details are not forgotten over time.
notes.settings.flow_tooltip:
How work notes flow
1. Paste a Slack / Jira link or a few words on the “Notes” page of the briefing window, Ctrl+Enter.
2. The fish writes the original verbatim to note/date-title.md (Obsidian format) and pushes it to AI-Base-Memory.
3. In the background, Claude Code in WSL (work account) follows the links read-only, writes a summary, picks the next reminder time and tags; the fish writes it back and pushes again. One automatic retry on failure.
4. When the time comes and you are at the computer, a sticky bubble appears: View / Later / Done.
5. “Open in Obsidian” jumps to the note (register the repo folder as a vault first).
Each note records which model it used, how many tokens and what it cost.
